Stotra-arc: rite (v1) → scrutiny (vv2–4) → madness-bliss (v5) → sudden-means (v6) → riddles dissolved (vv7–10) → fixing (v11) → descent (vv12–15) → red rite (v16) → grasping goddess (vv17–20) → ordaining three (v21) → sporting ground (vv22–23) → garland (v24) → Śiva-made shining (v25) → time-making cover (v26, live-fork noted not litigated) → resort (v27) → bowing (v28) → all-folk grace (v29) → dated seal 991 CE (v30). lines: To quit outer work, to dwell in noble knowing-ground —
show things undivided, waves gone fickle; grasp, goddess, maintenance's end, then grasp ever my wandering state's undoing, Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bahir vṛttiṃ hātuṃ citibhuvam udārāṃ nivasituṃ | sthiteḥ sāṃsārikyāḥ kalayatu vināśaṃ mama sadā

verses.craft: Quit-dwell-show; grasp-ends double (maintenance + mine); vinaṣṭormicapalaḥ per UNC.
